name: Tierz (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally, white at the upper hoist with a red cross and green at the lower fly, separated by a band of yellow, red and yellow from the lower hoist to the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Tierz; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band of yellow, red and yellow from the lower hoist to the upper fly
